subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> Target performer: young East Asian woman, early twenties, long dark wavy middle-parted hair with soft face-framing strands, fair skin, slim tall figure, small pearl earrings; facial identity, apparent age, hairstyle, hair color, skin tone, body proportions and stable anatomy jointly defined by <Picture 1>-<Picture 5>, with <Picture 1> as the primary facial anchor.
<Subject 2> Single shared scene of all five pictures: rain-damp city sidewalk at night; glossy dark pavement mirroring magenta, pink and cyan neon signage on the left; glass-fronted storefront with black metal frames, warm interior light and shallow entrance steps on the right; short curb bollards receding into the distance; low green shrubs; distant street-lamp and traffic bokeh under a dark sky.
<Subject 3> Outfit 1 (opening): cream ribbed-knit square-neck short-sleeve top, light-wash high-waisted straight-leg blue jeans, white platform sneakers.
<Subject 4> Outfit 2: white floral-lace spaghetti-strap mini dress with scalloped lace hem, white platform Mary Jane shoes.
<Subject 5> Outfit 3: leopard-print one-shoulder crop top, black high-waisted raw-hem denim shorts, black strappy stiletto sandals.
<Subject 6> Outfit 4: emerald-green velvet halter-neck gown with deep V wrap bodice and high thigh slit, black strappy high-heel sandals.
<Subject 7> Outfit 5: silver sequin off-shoulder bodycon mini dress, silver strappy high-heel sandals.
summary: reference generation; audio reference.
retention_analysis: Performer identity: fully_preserved. Opening outfit <Subject 3>: fully_preserved. Outfits <Subject 4>-<Subject 7>: attribute_transfer in picture order. <Picture 1> composition and framing (vertical full-body shot, centered subject, eye-level camera, head-to-toe visibility with modest headroom and footroom): fully_preserved. <Video 1> body motion, gesture order, rhythm and temporal structure: fully_preserved within its motion-only role. Lower-body motion only partially visible in the source: partially_preserved, completed with natural supporting footwork. Source-video camera, crop, framing, viewpoint and subject scale: no transfer relationship established. Source-video face, white sheer sleepwear, beige wall, wooden floor, indoor location, lighting and palette: excluded. Accompanying audio <Audio 1>: reference.
detailed_description: A 10-second cinematic vertical night-fashion video in one continuous shot. The shared environment from all used pictures is the only scene for the entire video and remains fully preserved from the first frame to the last frame. <Picture 1> is the composition and framing anchor: its shot scale, camera distance, camera height, perspective, subject size, subject placement, headroom, footroom, and visible body range govern the target video. <Video 1> supplies body motion and temporal structure only. Its source framing, crop, camera distance, viewpoint, subject scale, clothing, background, location, architecture, furniture, lighting, and color palette are not transferred. The reference motion is retargeted into the picture-defined composition without changing the target shot scale. The target remains one continuous shot in the shared picture environment. Opening: <Subject 1> in <Subject 3>, centered on the wet neon-lit sidewalk, head-to-toe visible, pink and cyan reflections shimmering on the pavement. Motion follows <Video 1>: arms raised behind the head gathering the hair, one hand brushing near the brow while the other rests at the chest, arms lowering into gentle shoulder-and-torso sway, rhythmic wrist-crossing and hand-rolling gestures unfolding at the chest, alternating side-to-side arm swings, and hand-crossing accents punctuating the beat; joint trajectories, center-of-gravity shifts, direction, velocity, momentum, pauses and gesture timing are preserved. The source shows roughly thigh-up, so the visible upper-body choreography is retained while the lower body receives natural, continuous, stable support: small rhythmic steps, clear weight shifts, grounded footwork, keeping the pictures' full-body shot scale. <Audio 1> supplies beat and phrase timing. The five outfits form five continuous audiovisual phrases: <Subject 3> phrase 1, <Subject 4> phrase 2, <Subject 5> phrase 3, <Subject 6> phrase 4, <Subject 7> phrase 5. Each of the four changes lands at the earliest co-accent frame on an adjacent-phrase boundary where a clear <Audio 1> beat, downbeat, impact or phrase change coincides with a <Video 1> foot plant, direction change, gesture hit, pose punctuation or weight shift; audio-visual sync and costume swap complete on the same frame. Prefer a clear medium co-accent at the correct boundary over a later stronger one; outfit 1 never dominates the runtime; changes avoid end-clustering; no phrase holds two changes; the final outfit keeps a complete closing phrase. Every change is a clean single-frame hard cut establishing the new garment and shoes together, without transition effects. Pose, joint angles, center of gravity, gaze, direction, velocity and momentum stay continuous across each swap; she dances on without pause, reset or change-specific gestures. One performer, one stable face, one continuous body and one continuous scene; no outfit mixing, residue, cloth clipping, deformation, extra limbs, flicker, text or watermark; the street never becomes an indoor room, corridor, studio or white wall. Ending: <Subject 7> completes the reference closing gesture in the same framing and scene. The performer remains silent throughout. Her lips stay gently closed, her jaw remains naturally relaxed, and her teeth and tongue stay hidden. Natural blinking, gaze changes, head turns, breathing, and a subtle closed-mouth smile are allowed. Source-video lip, jaw, tongue, phoneme, singing and speaking motion is not transferred; the music is off-screen and audience-only.
overall_soundscape: Soft night-street ambience beneath the music: distant traffic hum, faint neon shimmer, subtle footfalls and fabric swish synced to the dance; no speech, no singing, no performer vocals; all music is non-diegetic.
non_diegetic_music: The <Video 1> accompaniment (<Audio 1>) is the rhythmic reference: its tempo, steady beats, clear downbeats, percussive impacts and phrase changes organize the 10-second timeline; an instrumental score mirrors that beat structure and dynamic growth so each of the four outfit changes coincides with an audible clear downbeat aligned with a visible body accent; no lyrics, no vocals; heard solely by the audience while the performer stays silent.
